author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: I conceived also that the events of the present times, though we should beware of illusive hypotheses founded upon them, yet called for a special attention to prophecy.
claim: 현재의 사건들은 우리가 예언에 특별한 주의를 기울여야 함을 요구한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: They might also be expected to throw some light upon it.
claim: 현재의 사건들은 예언에 대한 특별한 주의를 필요로 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Some late writers upon the subject appear to understand many things which earlier ones did not ; and there is reason to expect that prophecy will be understood much better in years to come than it is at present.
claim: 미래에는 예언이 현재보다 더 잘 이해될 것이라고 기대할 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The exposition of a prophecy, dehvered in symboUcal language, must be Hable to many mistakes.
claim: 성경 예언의 해석은 상징적인 언어로 전달되기 때문에 많은 오류가 발생할 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: A style so highly figurative furnishes great scope for the imagination, which, unless it be accompanied with a sober and just judgment, will lead us into labyrinths of error.
claim: 비유적 언어로 된 예언의 해석은 상상력의 과도한 발현으로 인해 오류의 가능성이 높아질 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: This I know, my object has been to obtain its true meaning, and to communicate it in a manner suited, not to the curious, but to the Christian reader.
claim: 저자의 목적은 성경 예언의 진정한 의미를 얻고 그것을 기독교 독자에게 알맞은 방식으로 전달하는 것입니다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: We shall soon fol- low them.
claim: 저자들은 곧 죽음으로 친구들을 따라갈 것이라고 말합니다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The addresses to the seven churches are applicable to all other churches in similar circumstances, in all ages, but not prophetic — The things which the apostle was commanded to write being those which he had seen, those which if)f re, and those which should be hereafter, prove that the prophecy commences, not from the time of the vision, but probably from the ascension of Christ, in like manner as the four monarchies of Daniel commenced from the rising up of the Babylonish empire, many years before the time of the vision .
claim: 요한계시록의 예언은 그리스도의 승천 때부터 시작되며, 일곱 교회에 대한 말씀은 모든 시대와 모든 교회에 적용될 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The book of sevkn seals contains ^^He whole of the prophecy, the trumpets being only a subdivision of the seventh seal, and the vials of the seventh trumpet Chapters iv, v.
claim: 계시록의 일곱 인은 전체 예언을 포함하며, 나팔은 일곱 번째 인의 하위 분류이고, 잔은 일곱 번째 나팔의 일부이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The opening of the Jirst seal, — on which appeared " a white horee, ani he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went foilh conquering and to conquer" — represents the great progress of the gospel in the apostolic age Chapter vi. 1, 3.
claim: 첫 번째 인의 개봉은 사도 시대에 복음이 크게 전파되는 것을 나타낸다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The opening of the second seal — on which there appeared " a red horse, and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and tbat they sliould kill one another," — signifies the wars between the Jews and the Romans, who had united in persecuting Christ and his followers Chapter vi. 3, 4.
claim: 요한계시록 6장 3-4절의 두 번째 인을 여는 것은 유대인과 로마인 사이의 전쟁을 상징하며, 그들은 그리스도와 그의 추종자를 박해하기 위해 연합했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The opening of the third seal — on which there appeared " a black horse, and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand, &c." — denotes a famine, or scarcity approaching to famine, in which the neces- saries of life would be required to be weighed out with the utmost care, and which was fulfilled during the reigns of the Antonines Chap. vi. 5, 6.
claim: 세 번째 인의 개시에서 나타난 검은 말과 그 위에 앉은 자가 손에 저울을 가지고 있는 것은 가뭄이나 식량 부족을 의미하며, 이는 안토니누스 시대에 이루어졌다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The opening of the fourth seal — on which there appeared " a pale horse, and his name that sat on him was Death, and hell followed,"-^ signifies great mortality, owing to the intrigues and intestine wars in the empire, between the years 193 and 270, which pl-oduced famine and pestilence, and by diminishing the number of men gave ascendancy to the beasts of prey Chap. vi. 7, 8.
claim: 第四의 인이 열렸을 때 나타난 죽음과 지옥은 193년부터 270년까지 제국 내에서 일어난 음모와 내전으로 인한 대규모 사망을 의미한다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: How long, 0 Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth ?
claim: 하나님은 지구上的 거주자들에 대한 우리의 피를 판단하고 복수하실 때가 언제인지 묻고 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: And white robes were given unto every one of them, and it was said unto them that they should rest [or wait] yet for a little season, until their fellow-servants also, and their brethren that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled." This seal represents the state of the church about the year 270, when it had endured nine out of ten of the heathen persecutions, and was about to endure the tenth under Dioclesian and Maximian, after which God would avenge their cause, by an utter overthrow of their persecutors .
claim: 백성들이 받은 하얀 옷과 잠시 기다리라는 말은 교회가 270년경에 이르러서 열 번의 이방인들의 박해 중 아홉 번을 견디고, 디오클레티아누스와 마크시미아누스 치하에서 열 번째 박해를 겪은 후에 하나님께서 그들의 원수를 báo복하시리라는 것을 상징한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The opening of the sixth seal — on which appeared " an earthquake," and as it were a day of judgment, — signified the revolution of Constan- tine when the pagan empire was overthrown, and the prayers of the souls under the altar were answered Chap. vi. 12 — 17.
claim: 제6인의 인을 여는 것은 콘스탄틴의 혁명과 이교도 제국의 전복, 그리고 제단 아래 있는 영혼들의 기도가 응답받은 것을 상징한다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The " sealing of the servants of God in their foreheads," portends danger to the spiritual interests of the church from its outward prosper- ity, and distinguishes the faithful from the crowd of nominal Christians that would now be pressing into it Chap. vii. 1 — 8.
claim: 하나님의 종들의 이마에 인을 함은 교회의 외적인 번영으로 인해 영적 이익에 위험이 찾아올 수 있으며, 신실한 자들을 명목상의 기독교인들로부터 구별한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: This chapter concludes with a vision of the martyrs who had overcome, serving to strengthen the servants of God to encounter new trials.
claim: 순교자들의 비전은 하나님의 종들이 새로운 시련을 대처할 수 있도록 강화한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The seventh seal is opened — A solemn pause ensues — It is then subdi- vided into SEVEN TRUMPETS, which are put into the hands of se%'^en angels ; and the sounding of them is prefaced by " another angel's offering up the prayers of the saints with much incense, filling his censer with fire,
claim: 일곱 번째 인은 열리고, 일곱 천사에게 일곱 나팔이 주어지며, 성도들의 기도를 많은 분향香과 함께 드리는 다른 천사의 나팔 소리가 앞서간다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: and casting it into the earth, denoting that the judgments to be brought by the trumpets would be in answer to their prayers .
claim: 나팔로 가져올 심판은 그들의 기도에 대한 응답으로 일어날 것임을 나타낸다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The sounding oi the first four trumpets, which affect " the earth, the sea, the fountains of waters, and the sun, moon, and stars," denote the (tontinental, the maritime, and the mountainous parts of the empire, by the invasion of the northern nations, the issue of which was the ecUpse of the government, supreme and subordinate.
claim: 첫 네 나팔의 소리로 땅과 바다와 물의 샘과 해와 달과 별들이 영향을 받는 것은 북방 민족의 침략으로 인한 정부의 종말을 의미한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: As the seals overthrew the pagan empire, these overthrew the Christian . . .
claim: 첫 네 나팔의 소리로 인해 기독교 제국이 무너진다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The sounding of the fifth, or first woe-trumpet, on which followed " smoke from the bottomless pit, and locusts," represents popery as filling the world with infernal darkness, and thus preparing the way for Mahometan delusion and depredation Chap. ix. 1 — 12.
claim: 제5번 나팔, 즉 첫 번째 재앙의 나팔이 울렸을 때 지옥의 구렁에서 연기와 메뚜기가 나와 세계를 지옥의 어둠으로 채우고 마호메트의 환상과 약탈을 준비한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The sixth, or second woe-trumpet, is complex, relating partly to the " loosing of the four angels in Euphrates," followed by " an army of horsemen," and partly to the conduct of " the rest of the men, who were not killed by these plagues," — the first denoting the rise and rav- ages of the Turks, by whom the eastern empire, and with it the Greek church, were overthrown; and the last, the idolatries and cruelties of the members of the western church, who, instead of taking warning from the fate of the eastern, repented not, but persisted in corrupting the religion of Jesus Christ, and in persecuting his witnesses.
claim: 여섯 번째 나팔, 즉 두 번째 재앙의 나팔은 복잡하며, 부분적으로 유프라테스에 있는 네 천사를 놓아주는 것과 관련이 있으며, 그 뒤를 이어 기병대가 나타나고, 부분적으로는 이 재앙으로 죽지 않은 남은 사람들의 행동과 관련이 있다. 이는 첫 번째 경우에는 터키의 등장과 그들이 동로마 제국과 그리스도 교회를 전복시킨 것을 나타내고, 두 번째 경우에는 서방 교회의 구성원들이 동방의 운명에서 경고를 받지 못하고 회개하지 않고 오히려 예수 그리스도의 종교를 부패시키고 그의 증인들을 박해하는 우상숭배와 잔인함을 나타낸다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The vision of the angel with " a little book open," whose cry was followed by " seven thunders," refers to the Western, or papal church, which the prophecy now goes some ages back to take up, and which occupies the whole of what follows, till the beast and the false prophet are taken, or down to the times of the Millennium.
claim: 요한계시록의 예언은 서방교회, 즉 가톨릭교회를 언급하며, 이 예언은 千년왕국 시대까지 이어지는 내용을 다룬다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The " thunders" may probably refer to the same things in the form of a general threatening, which are afterwards particularly disclosed under the vials : for it appears to be of their execution that the angel swears by Him that liveth for ever and ever that there shall be no delay ; but that in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, (that is, in the times of the pouring out of the vials) the mystery of God should be finish- ed." This accounts for the command "not to write them," as they would be particularized under the vials Chap. x.
claim: 일곱 번의 우레는 후에 七つの 대접 아래서 특히 공개되는 것과 같은 것을 일반적인 위협의 형태로 언급할 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The eleventh and three following- chapters are considered as three general descriptions of the false church, chiefly under the 1260 years of antichristian usurpation, together with the state of the true churck during the same period.
claim: 요한계시록의 11장부터 14장까지는 거짓 교회에 대한 일반적인 설명으로, 주로 1260년의 반기독교 세력의 침탈 기간과 같은 기간 동안의 참된 교회의 상태를 다룬다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: These general descriptions of course are not confined to the times of this or that trumpet, but comprehend those of the greater part of the trumpets.
claim: 계시록의 11장부터 14장까지는 거짓 교회에 대한 일반적인 설명이며, 이는 주로 1260년의 반기독교 세력의 침탈 기간과 같은 시기에 真實한 교회의 상태를 포함한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The Jirst general description, contained in the eleventh chapter, de- nominates the false church " gentiles," and the true church " wit- nesses," who bear testimony against them.
claim: 거짓 교회는 '이방인'으로, 참된 교회는 거짓 교회에 대해 증언하는 '증인'으로 불린다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It leaves out of " the tem- ple of God" the place occupied by the former.
claim: 거짓 교회는 성전에서 배제된다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It represents, by the " slaughter of the witnesses," the prevalence of the antichristian party; by their " resurrection and ascension to heaven," the protestant refor- mation ; and by the " earthquake," in which a tenth part of the city fell, (and which, by the way, marks the termination of the sixth, or second woe-trumpet) the late revolution in France.
claim: 일곱 번째 천사님의 나팔 소리는 복음의 진행을 알리는 신호이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: By the sounding of the seventh angel, a signal is given of the progress of the gospel.
claim: 일곱 번째 천사의 나팔 소리는 복음의 진행을 알리는 신호이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: And by the song of the heavenly choir, are intimated the judgments which should be inflicted on the antichristian party, and the Millennial glory that should follow Chap. xi.
claim: 하늘의 합창에 의하여, 안티크리스당에 가해질 심판과 그 후에 따른 천년왕국 영광이 암시된다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The second general description, contained in the twelfth chapter, repre- sents the true church prior to the introduction of antichristian corrup- tions, as " clothed with the sun, having the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars." These corruptions originate in a third part of the stars of heaven being drawn from their orbits by the tail of the dragon, and cast upon the earth ; or by the rulers of tlie church being seduced by the riches and honours of the Roman empire.
claim: 진정한 교회는 안티크리스투스적인 부패가 도입되기 전에 태양으로 옷 입고, 발 아래에 달을 가지고, 머리 위에 열두 개의 별의 관을 쓴 것으로 나타난다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The dragon having thus prevailed over a part of the Christian church, aims to devour the other.
claim: 용이 기독교 교회 일부를 정복한 후 나머지 교회를 삼키려고 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The true church fleeth into the wilderness, where she exists without legal protection or toleration, till the Reformation m the sixteenth century, when Michael fights her battles, and the dragon is cast down.
claim: 진정한 교회는 광야로 피신하여 16세기 종교개혁 때까지 법적 보호나 관용 없이 존재하며, 그 때에 미카엘이 교회의 전투를 치루고 용이 물리침을 받는다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Succeeding persecutions are the eflfect of his defeat.
claim: 용의 패배 이후에 이어지는 박해는 그의 패배의 결과이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The ffiird general description, contained in the thirteenth and four- teenth chapters, represents " a beast rising out of the sea, with seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, &c." signifying that secular government by which the false church has been all along support- ed— namely.
claim: 세계 정부가 거짓 교회를 지지해 왔음

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The Roman empire under its last head, after it had been divided into (en independent kingdoms, each of which was a horn of the
claim: 로마 제국이 마지막 머리로 나온 후 독립 왕국으로 분할되어 각 왕국이 뿔이 된 것

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: When paganism was overthrown, the beast, in one of its heads was, "as it were, wounded to death ;" but when Christianity became so corrupted as to be paganized, " the deadly wound was healed."
claim: 이방교가 전복되었을 때, 짐승의 하나의 머리는 죽음으로 상처를 입었지만, 기독교가 이방교화되어 부패했을 때, 그 치명적인 상처는 회복되었다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller

author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: 1 Unto the angel of the church of EpkesuSf write ; These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks ; 2 / know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil : and thoii hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not ; and hast found them liars : 3 And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name^s sake hast laboured^ and hast not fainted. 4 Nevertheless, I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love. 5 Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works ; or else I will come unto thee gitickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent. 6 But this thou hast, that thou hateth the deeds of the Nicolaitanes, ivhich I also hate. 7 He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

Acts xix. 10.

Altogether, this is a high character.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse

source_text: You have also a prospect of still enjoying his ordinances^ Look up for his gracious influence to attend them, knowing that neither is he who planteth any thing, nor he who watereth ; but it is God who giveth the increase.

author: Andrew Fuller

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Yet forget not to be thankful, that ever the Lord raised up such a minister, and gave you the chief benefit of his labours.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It was the kindness of Providence that fixed him in this place, and con- tinued him with you for several years.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You have reason to bless God also, that he did not run in vain, nor labour in vain.
claim: 하나님께 감사해야 할 이유가 있다. 왜냐하면 그가 헛되지 않게 달렸고, 헛되지 않게 노력했기 때문이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Bless the Lord forgiving so many seals to his ministry, and for enabling him to live so honourably, and to die so triumphantly.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If any of you put him out of his place, and idolized him; let such learn wisdom in future, and so account of us, as only the stewards of the mysteries of God.

author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If any undervalued him, let them sin- cerely repent of that evil.

author: Andrew Fuller

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Remember the consistent and love- ly example which he set before you ; and the evidence of the truth of religion, and the display of the faithfulness of God, which was made his supports, under his painful and protracted at- fiiction.
claim: 하나님의 신실하심과 종교의 진리는 고통과 시련 가운데서도 나타난다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: membering how essential a part of pure and undefiled religion it is, to pay kind attention to the orphan and the widow in their affliction ; and accounting it an honour to imitate and subserve that glorious Being, in whom the fatherless findeth mercy, and who encourages the desolate widow to put her trust in him.
claim: 순수하고 더럽혀지지 않은 종교의 본질적인 부분은 고아와 과부가 고통받을 때 그들에게 친절한 주의를 보이는 것이다.

author: Andrew Fuller

author: Andrew Fuller

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: In looking out for a minister, I trust, you will be careful to seek one of the same stamp with my late dear brother; one, who will guide you in the true narrow way, and guard you from error on the right hand and on the left; who will warn you against every sen- timent which would dishonour God's moral government, as well as faithfully oppose whatever notion would disparage the riches of his glorious grace.
claim: 하나님의 道를 따르는 목회자를 선택해야 하며, 그는 진정한 구원과 하나님의 은혜를 가르치고, 오류와 죄로부터 신자를 보호해야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: May you choose a man equally zealous against self-righteousness, and against self-indulgence : who will preach salvation by Christ alone, and insist on deliverance from the power and love of sin, as a most essential part of that salvation.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller

May he be able to appeal to you, on his death-bed, in the words of the same apostle, " As we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, so we spake, not as pleasing men, but God, who trieth our hearts : not using flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloak of covetousness, God is witness ; nor seeking glory of men ; but we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children ; so, being affec- tionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto

Such a protestation, I am confident, your late beloved pastor might have safely made, and I pray God his successor may be assisted to imitate the same primitive example, and find a corresponding testimony in the conscience of every unprejudiced hearer.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse

claim: 하나님의 사람에게는 외적인 인기나 재능보다 하나님께 헌신된 마음이 더 중요하다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse

source_text: Then he told some, that his highest comfort, amidst the symptoms of approaching disso- lution, which he then exhibited, was the expectation of meeting them in heaven; while he forewarned others of you, that his greatest anxiety arose from his fear of being obliged to witness against you, as despisers and rejecters of the glorious Redeemer.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If any of you know of other faults belonging to him, be careful to shun them ; but O be sure to follow him, wherein he was a follower of Christ.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: While his outward conduct was remarkably blameless and ex- emplary, he evidently had a deep, abiding, humbling sense of the evil of sin, of his own native depravity, and remaining sinfulness ; of his absolute need of Christ as an atoning sacrifice, and the Lord his righteousness ; and of the love of the Spirit, and the im- portance of his work as a sanctifier. — He lived a life of faith on the incarnate Son of God, as the blessed Mediator who had loved him and given himself for him ; and as Christ was all in all to him, his joy and his gain, in life and in death, so he took great delight in preaching Christ to others, as the only and all-sufficient Saviour ; he earnestly longed, had it been permitted him by Providence, to have preached Christ to the heathen, and would have been glad to have carried the tidings of salvation by his blood, to the ends of the earth.
claim: 그리스도인의 삶은 죄의 악성과 그리스도의 속죄의 필요성, 성령의 사랑과 성화의 중요성을 깊이 인식하는 데 기반해야 하며, 이 인식은 그리스도를 다른 사람에게 전하는 삶으로 나타나야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 6: Expository Discourses on the Apocalypse
